name: Evidence Action Accelerator Renewal BOTEC (November 2021)
summary: Funds Evidence Action's Accelerator, which finds and tests new programs to scale up. GiveWell's spreadsheet "Evidence Action Accelerator Renewal BOTEC (November 2021)", linked from its grant page. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.

resources.title: GiveWell grant page (Evidence Action Accelerator renewal december 2021)

rows.label: How long we fund opportunities incubated by Accelerator (years)
rows.explainer: GiveWell's input behind the present value, read from the sheet so the present value moves with your discount rate.

rows.label: How fast these opportunities get worse each year
rows.explainer: GiveWell's assumption that the cost-effectiveness of funding opportunities falls by 5% a year; it is not time preference, so the discount slider leaves it alone.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar from Evidence Action grant per year
rows.explainer: Calculated in the source sheet as `=(B15-B16)/(B3*1000000)`; kept as a fixed number here, as the yearly amount the present value below discounts.

rows.label: Present discounted value of additional units of value per dollar
rows.explainer:
GiveWell's `=pv(B17,B11,-B18,,1)`, rebuilt from the sheet's own inputs so the present value moves with your discount rate.

Calculation

rows.label: Units of value per dollar, GiveDirectly
Cost-effectiveness of this grant in expectation (x cash)
Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly
rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for research, technical assistance and policy work: mostly people. Our judgment; we haven't seen this grant's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Researchers and advisers could typically earn considerably more in consulting or industry. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
